pretreatment: degreased in acetone and alcohol and chemically etched
evidence: Previously to the growth experiments, the substrates were degreased in acetone and alcohol and chemically etched. (1 1 1) or (1 0 0) oriented GaAs substrates were etched with H2SO4:H2O2:H2O (5:1:1) solution for 3 min and (1 0 0) oriented Si substrates with H2SO4:H2O2 (4:1) solution for 3 min followed by HF (48%) for 20 s.
